detached_structure.evidence: A reddish-roofed structure or deck-like addition sits at the rear (north) edge of the main house, inside the outline, but it may be an attached extension rather than a separate building.

signals.notes: Narrow lot with a bare dry backyard to the north and dense trees along the east and south edges; one light-colored vehicle is parked near the front of the house, and the red-roofed buildings to the east belong to the neighbor.
